en.headline: Department of Health runs Mental Recharge Station through Sunday
en.dek: The free event at MOSTown in Ma On Shan continues until Sunday evening to mark World Mental Health Day, with interactive games, workshops and a focus on listening to lived experience.
body: The Department of Health is holding a three-day Mental Recharge Station at MOSTown in Ma On Shan from 9 to 11 October to mark World Mental Health Day on 10 October.

The free event runs from noon to 8pm daily and includes interactive experiences, games and workshops. The Department said it encourages people to pay more attention to mental health and to listen to those around them.

This year’s theme set by the World Federation for Mental Health is “Lived Experiences Heard: Real Voices, Real Change”. Director of Health Dr Ronald Lam said mental health is an important part of overall health, and that the Chief Executive’s first five-year plan and 2026 Policy Address both call for stronger community support.

The Department of Health launched the 18111 EmoCare hotline in December 2023. As of 30 September this year, staff had handled nearly 352,900 calls and 6,250 WhatsApp messages. High-risk cases are referred to regional partners for further care.
The Mental Recharge Station is open at the atrium of MOSTown until Sunday. The Department appealed to the public to join over the weekend to help build a more inclusive community.

zh.headline: 衞生署「心靈補給站」馬鞍山展至周日
zh.dek: 為響應世界精神衞生日，衞生署在馬鞍山新港城中心舉辦免費活動，由周五起至周日傍晚，設互動遊戲及工作坊，強調聆聽親身經歷。
body: 衞生署由10月9日至11日在馬鞍山新港城中心舉辦一連三日的「心靈補給站」，響應10月10日的世界精神衞生日。
活動每日中午12時至晚上8時免費開放，設互動體驗、遊戲及工作坊。衞生署表示，鼓勵市民多關注精神健康，並多聆聽身邊人。
世界心理衞生聯盟今年主題為「傾聽親身經歷：以真實的聲音推動真正的改變」。衞生署署長林文健醫生說，精神健康是整體健康的重要一環，行政長官的第一個五年規劃及2026年施政報告均提出加強社區支援。
衞生署於2023年12月推出「情緒通」18111熱線。截至今年9月30日，專業人員已處理近35.29萬宗來電及6250個WhatsApp短訊。高風險個案會轉介地區夥伴跟進。
「心靈補給站」設於新港城中心天幕廣場，展期至周日。衞生署呼籲市民把握周末參與，共建包容社區。
